name: Network Partition & Quorum-Constrained Leadership
description: Evaluates swarm behavior under constellation network partitions where global and connected quorum is unavailable. Coordinator SAT-07 suffers catastrophic node loss at t=2.0s; the recovery engine detects the loss, evaluates connected components, and honestly reports UNRESOLVED leadership without split-brain or fabricated elections.

scheduled_faults.description: Catastrophic coordinator spacecraft loss under fragmented network topology
